name: Wave Assist
description: Assist: rescues the player on the last frame before death in every gamemode, remembers rescues and clicks earlier next time, with an Assist button in the pause menu.

assist-enabled.name: Enable Assist
assist-enabled.description: Turn the assist on or off.

assist-method.name: Method
assist-method.description: Rescue = step back 1 step and click. Rewind = step back several steps and click.

rewind-steps.name: Rewind Steps
rewind-steps.description: How many physics steps to go back in Rewind method.

assist-learn.name: Learn from rescues
assist-learn.description: Remember where a rescue was needed and click there earlier in the next attempts.

learn-margin.name: Learn margin
learn-margin.description: How many units earlier to click on learned spots. Higher = safer but may click too early.

max-rescues.name: Max rescues without progress
max-rescues.description: After this many rescues without moving forward the player is allowed to die. 0 = unlimited.

miss-chance.name: Miss chance (%)
miss-chance.description: Chance that the assist does not save you, to look more human.

practice-only.name: Only in practice mode
practice-only.description: Use the assist only in practice mode.
